title: Deadly Protests Erupt in Bangladesh Over Exiled Former Leader. What to Know.
summary: Supporters of the deposed prime minister, Sheikh Hasina, who was sentenced to death in absentia, have waged a small-scale insurgency to destabilize the current government.
